results.title: Withdraw under a read-only permission
results.evidence: `withdraw_comment` authorises `document:read` where `comment` authorises `document:review`. Somebody else is stopped by the register rather than by the route — 'not_your_comment' — so the reachable case is narrow and real: a reviewer whose `document:review` has been revoked still holds `document:read`, and can still close the objections they raised while they had it.
